name: Ash-Pike Conscript
lore: Levied from the kiln villages, given a pike and a direction.

name: Rope-Sandal Runner
lore: Carries orders faster than the horses can be saddled.

name: Emberline Archer
lore: Trained to loose on the drumbeat and not before.

name: Kiln-Gate Spearman
lore: Holds the pottery road where the smoke is thickest.

name: Lacquer Shield Bearer
lore: Twelve coats of lacquer, one for each year of service.

name: Wave-Cut Ronin
lore: Masterless, but the cut remembers its school.

name: Storm-Petal Naginata
lore: Sweeps the low line so the archers keep their footing.

name: Ash Falcon Outrider
lore: Rides the ridge lines and reports what the smoke hides.

name: Retainer of the Dawn Edge
lore: Keeps the commander's seal and the commander's temper.

name: Nine-Fold Fletcher
lore: Nine arrows nocked, nine names already chosen.

name: Iron Chrysanthemum Captain
lore: Rebuilt the line at Kiln Gate with forty survivors.

name: Kiln Warden
lore: Stands in the gateway because the gateway is the province.

name: Duelist of the Red Verandah
lore: Has never fought indoors and never lost outside.

name: Banner-Sworn Daimyo
lore: Swore the banner would not fall; it has not.

name: Oni-Mask Executioner
lore: Wears the mask so the province need not learn the face.

name: Tide-Breaker of the Salt Coast
lore: Held a landing alone until the tide took the boats back.

name: Sword Saint of the Quiet Province
lore: Teaches one student a decade; none have surpassed the first.

name: The Shogun's Silent Hand
lore: Not listed in any muster roll, present at every succession.

name: Kagaribi, the Unsheathed Dawn
lore: The last sword saint of the old line. Draws once; the province rewrites its maps after.

divine.arrival: The draw is heard before it is seen: every enemy on the field loses 10 morale.

name: The Hundred-Province Shogun
lore: Held a hundred provinces with one oath and never needed a second.

divine.arrival: Every allied Samurai stands: allies recover 25 morale and Broken doctrine counts as Reduced.

name: Ditch-Lantern Scout
lore: Carries an unlit lantern; the light is for leaving, not arriving.

name: Paper-Wall Listener
lore: Paid by the sentence, never by the hour.

name: Kite-String Archer
lore: Ranges by kite line, looses by memory.

name: Sedge-Mask Infiltrator
lore: Enters as a reed cutter, leaves as nobody.

name: Cistern Runner
lore: Knows which wells connect and which only look like they do.

name: Split-Tongue Forger
lore: Has signed forty seals, none of them twice.

name: Rain-Gutter Assassin
lore: Waits for the third night of rain, never the first.

name: Hollow-Reed Diver
lore: Breathes through a reed for as long as the guard shift lasts.

name: Lieutenant of the Quiet Ledger
lore: Keeps the debts that keep the network.

name: Mirror-Lamp Illusionist
lore: Sells the same room to three different watchmen.

name: Jonin of the Sedge Gate
lore: Has not been seen by a superior in nine years and is still obeyed.

name: Nightingale-Floor Breaker
lore: Crosses singing floors without waking the song.

name: Ash-Vein Poisoner
lore: Works in three doses: sleep, silence, and the last one.

name: Sky-Hook Rooftop Adept
lore: Fights only above the second storey.

name: Severed-Name Handler
lore: Runs six cells; none of them know the other five exist.

name: Twin-Shade Executioner
lore: Arrives twice; only one of the arrivals is real.

name: The Widow of the Salt Ledger
lore: Collected every debt in the ledger and then burned it.

name: Grandmaster of the Unwritten School
lore: The school has no scrolls; losing a student loses a technique forever.

name: Yoi, the Hundred Shadows
lore: Nobody has confirmed she is one person. Four of her have been killed; the killings changed nothing.

divine.arrival: Every enemy commander is Exposed for one round; nothing on the field can Hide from this unit.

name: The Moonless Verdict
lore: Not a name — a sentence passed. Those who hear it read do not hear it finished.

divine.arrival: All lights fail: every enemy loses 20 morale and cannot use Overwatch next round.

name: Hedge-Levy Billman
lore: Owns a bill, a helm, and a field he would like to return to.

name: Chapel Runner
lore: Carries the chapter's word between keeps.

name: Ivory Wall Crossbow
lore: Loads behind the shield line, looses over it.

name: Ivory Bastion Man-at-Arms
lore: The wall is made of these.

name: Gate-Oath Sergeant
lore: Swore at the gate, will be buried in it.

name: Lamp-Vigil Squire
lore: Keeps the vigil lamps that mark the watch line.

name: Blue-Field Lancer
lore: Trained for one charge per battle and one only.

name: Chapterhouse Warden
lore: Answers to the chapter, not to the crown.

name: Castellan of the Second Gate
lore: Has never opened the second gate and does not intend to.

name: Sun-Chapel Chaplain
lore: Keeps morale the way an engineer keeps a wall.

name: Marshal of the Ivory Road
lore: Holds the road that feeds three keeps.

name: Oathbreaker Hunter
lore: Hunts the ones who left; is very good at it.

name: Sky-Lance Dragoon Captain
lore: Trained his horses to stand under wingbeat.

name: Grand Warden of the Ivory Keep
lore: The keep has fallen twice; never while he stood in it.

name: Lord Marshal of the Blue Field
lore: Wins by refusing to be anywhere interesting.

name: Champion of the Standing Wall
lore: Two shields, no retreat order in his vocabulary.

name: The Vow-Kept Paladin
lore: Has kept every vow, including the ones that cost the most.

name: High Castellan of the Last Keep
lore: Commands the keep that has never been taken.

name: Aurelane, the Unbreakable Dawn
lore: Stood in the breach at Ivory Road for a day and a night. The breach is now a shrine.

divine.arrival: The line reforms: allies within 4 are Cleansed, recover 30 morale, and cannot be Routed this round.

name: The Last King's Lance
lore: The king is dead. The lance still rides the muster, and the muster still forms up behind it.

divine.arrival: A charge no one ordered: allied Cavalry gain +2 MOV and +300 ATK for two rounds.

name: Cliff-Nest Fledgling
lore: Barely flies. Bites regardless.

name: Slate Drake Runt
lore: The nest's smallest; the nest's meanest.

name: Ash-Gullet Whelp
lore: The breath is short and it knows it.

name: Scree Wyrmling
lore: Hunts the talus slopes where footing fails.

name: Slate Ridge Drake
lore: The Host's standard wing; ranges four ridges a day.

name: Thermal-Rider Scout
lore: Never flaps where it can climb.

name: Ridge-Claim Drake
lore: Territorial to the metre.

name: Cinder-Throat Drake
lore: Two breaths, then it fights like a beast.

name: Bonded Wing-Rider
lore: The rider matters less than the bond.

name: Stormvane Harrier
lore: Flies the weather other wings refuse.

name: Sky-Ledger Keeper
lore: Records which ridges the Host has claimed and which it will.

name: Ash-Wake Wyrm
lore: Leaves a line of ash where it passed.

name: Talon-Marshal
lore: Commands by wing signal; has never used a horn.

name: Basalt Ridgeback
lore: Walks when it wants to and it rarely wants to.

name: Glass-Storm Wyrm
lore: Breathes something between sand and lightning.

name: Cloud-Splitter Drake
lore: Named for the wake, not the weapon.

name: Wyrm-Sworn Dragoon
lore: Rider and wyrm share a name and refuse to say which came first.

name: Riftwing Claimant
lore: Holds a rift valley and everything that flies through it.

name: Obsidian Brood-Mother
lore: Everything on the ridge is either hers or leaving.

name: Storm-Gullet Ancient
lore: Old enough to remember when the ridge was a sea.

name: Vault-Keeper Wyrm
lore: Guards a hoard nobody has confirmed exists.

name: The Ridge-Line Tyrant
lore: Has eaten two rival Hosts and their territory claims.

name: Elder of the Nine Thermals
lore: Rode the nine thermals in one day; nothing else has.

name: The Sky-Bound Archon
lore: Speaks in weather. Answers are also weather.

name: Vharuun, the Skybreaker
lore: The Host does not describe him as a dragon. It describes the sky as his and everything else as visiting.

divine.arrival: The air splits: enemy flying units are grounded for a round and every enemy loses 20 morale.

name: Ossuvane, the Territorial Edict
lore: Does not fight for ground. Declares it, and the declaration has never yet been overturned.

divine.arrival: The edict is spoken: no enemy may fly for two rounds and allied Dragons gain +2 MOV.

name: Kaethyrra, the Wyrmfire Judgement
lore: Older than the Host's oldest claim. What she burns is not recorded as lost — it is recorded as settled.

divine.arrival: Everything within 5 hexes catches: enemies take 400 damage and terrain cover burns away.

name: Sunder-Peak Siege Wyrm
lore: Brought down a curtain wall by landing on it.

name: Gale-Herald
lore: Reads the wind for the whole wing.

name: Nest-Warden Drake
lore: Guards eggs; treats everything else as a threat to eggs.

name: Chalk-Line Acolyte
lore: Draws the circle; is not permitted inside it.

name: Rote-Speaker
lore: Knows the words, not the meaning. It is usually enough.

name: Salt-Ring Warden
lore: Keeps the ring unbroken while others speak.

name: Anchor-Stake Keeper
lore: Drives the stakes that hold a doorway open.

name: Foreign Ritualist
lore: Speaks four dead languages and one that is not dead yet.

name: Tongue-Broker
lore: Sells translations of things that should not be translated.

name: Circle-Binder
lore: Ties two circles together and hopes both hold.

name: Gate-Second
lore: Steps in when the speaker's voice gives out.

name: Hollow Choir
lore: Nine voices, one of them not counted in the muster.

name: Keeper of the Long Door
lore: Has kept one door open for eleven years.

name: Speaker of the Threefold Name
lore: Says two thirds of it aloud.

name: Anchor-Breaker
lore: Employed exclusively against other cults.

name: Hierophant of the Marsh Rite
lore: Runs the rite that made the marsh.

name: The Unfinished Sentence
lore: Halfway through an invocation begun four decades ago.

name: Vessel of the Long Invitation
lore: The cult stopped calling it a person some years ago. It still answers to the name, which is the worrying part.

divine.arrival: Every ritual circle on the field gains three progress and every portal cooldown is cleared.

name: Bramble Hedger
lore: Cuts hedge by day, plants it back by night.

name: Nettle Gleaner
lore: Harvests what stings and knows what it is for.

name: Thorn-Line Archer
lore: Fletches with briar; the wound closes wrong.

name: Root-Cellar Warden
lore: Guards the cellar where the coven keeps its winters.

name: Blood-Loam Tender
lore: Feeds the garden what the garden asks for.

name: Snare-Witch
lore: Never chases; the ground does that.

name: Hollow-Stem Stalker
lore: Moves through hedge the way water moves through sand.

name: Hex-Sign Cutter
lore: Cuts signs into bark; the bark keeps them.

name: Coven Second
lore: Holds the coven's second name, spoken only at succession.

name: Briar-Bound Champion
lore: Wears the briar; the briar wears back.

name: Wormwood Apothecary
lore: Two shelves: one for keeping people, one for the rest.

name: Mother of Small Thorns
lore: Every hedge in the valley reports to her.

name: Gallows-Root Colossus
lore: Grew where the gallows stood and kept the shape.

name: Whisper-Bark Hexer
lore: The trees repeat what she says, at night, to whoever is passing.

name: Warden of the Strangling Grove
lore: The grove has taken four companies; he has taken none of the credit.

name: Crone of the Split Trunk
lore: Two voices from one throat, both older than the coven.

name: The Red Orchard Keeper
lore: The orchard bears in winter. Nobody eats from it.

name: First Seed of the Coven
lore: Claims to be the oldest thing the coven planted.

name: Sythra, the Garden of Knives
lore: Where she stands becomes garden. What the garden takes, it keeps standing up, and the standing ones are hers.

divine.arrival: Briars erupt across the field: all Open terrain within 4 becomes Forest and enemies there are rooted.

name: The Root of the World
lore: The coven did not plant it. The coven formed around it, and has never agreed on what it is waiting for.

divine.arrival: The ground answers: every enemy within 5 is rooted for one round and loses 25 morale.

name: Lamp-Bearer Aniel
lore: Carries a light it is not permitted to set down.

name: Threshold Seriel
lore: Stands in doorways. Only doorways.

name: Errand-Wing Kaziel
lore: Delivers, waits for an answer, delivers the answer.

name: Watch-Feather Nuriel
lore: Looses once per watch and records why.

name: Ash-Herald Ophiel
lore: Announces what has already been decided.

name: Choir-Second Ramiel
lore: Keeps the choir in time when the choir is under fire.

name: Archangel Vareliel, the Standard
lore: The banner the Host forms on. There is one banner.

name: Archangel Sorachiel, the Answering Blade
lore: Answers challenges. Only challenges. Always.

name: Archangel Immureth, the Sealed Gate
lore: Was set at a gate and has not been relieved.

name: Archangel Nethanel, the Mending Hand
lore: Repairs what the Host breaks, in the order the Host broke it.

name: Archangel Zaruel, the Sundering Trumpet
lore: The note is not music. It is a measurement, and things fail it.

name: Archangel Kaphriel, the Ledger of Names
lore: Reads a name aloud and the name stops being carried by anyone.

name: Archangel Yehoriel, the Held Line
lore: Has held one line since the line was drawn.

name: Archangel Malkiriel, the Drawn Verdict
lore: Does not argue. Has never had to.

name: Principality of the Salt Coast
lore: Governs a coastline and considers the ships incidental.

name: Principality of the Kiln Road
lore: Governs a road; the road has never been closed.

name: Principality of the Drowned March
lore: Governs a marsh that has been under water for a century.

name: Power of the Barred Way
lore: Bars a way. Does not explain the way.

name: Power of the Ninth Watch
lore: Keeps the watch nobody volunteers for.

name: Power of the Broken Circle
lore: Assigned exclusively against ritual circles.

name: Virtue of the Turning Hour
lore: Adjusts when things happen, slightly.

name: Virtue of the Unbroken Vow
lore: Holds vows upright when the vow-holder cannot.

name: Dominion of the Third Sphere
lore: Issues orders to Powers and never to people.

name: Dominion of the Silent Register
lore: Keeps the register of what has been permitted.

name: Throne of the Weighed Measure
lore: A seat, occupied. The occupant is not the interesting part.

name: Throne of the Standing Judgement
lore: Judgement, already made, standing where it was made.

name: Cherub of the Four Faces
lore: Four faces, four directions, no turning; it goes where the faces already look.

name: Ophanim, the Wheels Within Wheels
lore: Rings inside rings, rimmed with open eyes, and it does not turn as it goes — it is already facing you.

divine.arrival: The rings open: nothing may be Hidden, and every enemy within 4 is Exposed for two rounds.

name: The Seraph of Six Wings
lore: Two wings over the face, two over the feet, two to fly. The covering is a courtesy and the courtesy is for you.

divine.arrival: The voice is heard at the doorposts: enemies within 5 lose 30 morale, allies within 5 are Cleansed.

name: The Seraph of the Burning Coal
lore: It carries the coal with tongs because even it will not hold that directly.

divine.arrival: Every allied unit is Cleansed and every enemy ritual loses half its progress.

name: The Cherub of Wheels and Eyes
lore: Four faces, four wings, calves like burnished bronze, and beneath it the wheels that do not need it.

divine.arrival: It looks in every direction at once: the whole field is revealed permanently.

name: Archangel Ithuriel, Herald of the Last Hour
lore: The last archangel on the muster, kept back for the hour the Host does not name. One copy exists. There has never been a need for two.

divine.arrival: The hour is called: two fallen allies return at half hit points and every ally recovers 30 morale.

name: Copper-Wire Levy
lore: Wears wire so the clan can find the body afterwards.

name: Rod-Bearer Initiate
lore: Holds the rod. That is the entire duty and it is not a small one.

name: Sparkstep Runner
lore: Runs the ridge between strikes.

name: Fulgurite Spearman
lore: Spear tipped with glass the storm made.

name: Stormcaller Apprentice
lore: Can call the small ones reliably.

name: Thunder-Drum Warden
lore: Drums the count the clan fights to.

name: Arc-Blade Warrior
lore: The blade holds a charge for exactly one exchange.

name: Bolt-Reader
lore: Reads where the next one will land, usually in time.

name: Skyfall Adept
lore: Calls down, never across.

name: Clan-Second of the Long Rod
lore: Carries the rod that grounds the whole line.

name: Thunderstep Duelist
lore: Arrives on the sound, not before it.

name: Gale-Rider
lore: Rides ahead of the front and turns with it.

name: Stormcaller of the Ninth Peal
lore: Counts peals; acts on the ninth.

name: Chain-Warden
lore: Chained to the ground on purpose.

name: Clan-Captain of the Rolling Front
lore: Moves the clan the way weather moves.

name: Fulgur-Lance Champion
lore: One lance, held charged for the whole engagement.

name: Tempest Warden
lore: Keeps the storm off the clan and on everyone else.

name: Sky-Anvil Siege Caller
lore: Calls strikes on walls, patiently, all day.

name: Thunderstep Grandmaster
lore: Has crossed a battlefield in four sounds.

name: Storm-Clad Vanguard
lore: Armoured in something that is still discharging.

name: Elder Stormcaller
lore: Has called the front down on her own valley twice, deliberately.

name: Clan-Lord of the Split Sky
lore: Rules a clan that measures rank in strikes survived.

name: The Unearthed Blade
lore: Dug out of a fulgurite field, still warm.

name: Archmage of the Standing Column
lore: Holds a column of lightning upright for as long as she is standing.

name: Verakh, the First Strike
lore: The clan's founding blade. The clan does not claim he calls the storm — it claims the storm has learned to arrive when he does.

divine.arrival: The front arrives with him: every enemy takes 300 damage and allied Storm units gain +300 ATK.

name: Ilzareth, the Sky Answers
lore: She does not petition the sky. She states a thing, and the sky agrees loudly enough to break ground.

divine.arrival: A standing column opens over the field: every round, enemies in the open take 300 damage.

name: Water-Carrier Novice
lore: Carries water up the stair. That is the training.

name: Bell-Hour Novice
lore: Wakes the order and is woken by nobody.

name: Staff-Form Brother
lore: One form, ten thousand repetitions.

name: Silent Refectory Cook
lore: Feeds the order without speaking to it.

name: Stone-Garden Sweeper
lore: Rakes the garden; the garden is a defensive diagram.

name: Open-Palm Adept
lore: Has not held a weapon in nine years.

name: Mountain-Stair Runner
lore: Runs the thousand stairs twice daily, armoured.

name: Breath-Count Healer
lore: Counts the wounded down to a survivable rhythm.

name: Stillpoint Warden
lore: The stance has a name and the name is the whole technique.

name: Brother of the Turning Wheel
lore: Fights in a circle so nothing gets behind the order.

name: Abbot of the Low Cloister
lore: Runs a cloister of forty and a temper of one.

name: Keeper of the Written Breath
lore: Writes the breath down; the writing is the technique.

name: Iron-Sash Sister
lore: The sash is iron and so is the pace she sets.

name: Warden of the Unswept Path
lore: The path is unswept because nobody has walked it and lived to leave prints.

name: The Abbot Who Does Not Rise
lore: Has not stood in eleven years. Nothing has needed him to.

name: Grandmaster of the Turning Wheel
lore: Holds the wheel's only complete lineage.

name: Sister of the Last Mantra
lore: Knows the mantra the order stopped teaching.

name: The Ninefold Ascetic
lore: Nine disciplines, nine masteries, no possessions.

name: Jorenn, the Empty Hand
lore: Sat in the pass for a season. Two armies chose different routes. Neither has explained why.

divine.arrival: The field goes quiet: no unit may use a Reaction for one round.

name: The Unmoved of the High Cloister
lore: Has been described as a person, a doctrine, and a feature of the terrain. The order does not correct any of the three.

divine.arrival: Stillness spreads: allies within 4 cannot be pushed, rooted or Routed for two rounds.

name: Temple-Gate Sohei
lore: Took the vow and kept the naginata.

name: Ash-Robe Ronin Monk
lore: Masterless twice: once by the house, once by the order.

name: Abbot-Captain of the Kiln Cloister
lore: Runs a cloister that musters like a company.

name: Steel-Mantra Duelist
lore: Recites the form while cutting it.

name: Sesshu, the Silent Temple
lore: The temple did not fall. Everything that came to take it stopped speaking, and then stopped.

divine.arrival: The bell does not ring: every enemy caster is Silenced for one round.

name: Night-Draw Retainer
lore: Serves a house that does not list him.

name: Veiled Banner Ronin
lore: Carries a banner rolled up so it cannot be read.

name: Two-School Duelist
lore: Opens formally, finishes otherwise.

name: Shadow-Sworn Captain
lore: Commands openly, is obeyed quietly.

name: Rin, Two Blades One Breath
lore: Trained in a school that no longer admits it existed, by a house that no longer admits she did.

divine.arrival: Two openings at once: enemy commanders lose all Guarded status and are Exposed for a round.

name: Wyrm-Oath Squire
lore: Swore to a knight and to something much older.

name: Scaled Bastion Rider
lore: Carries a tower shield aloft, which should not work.

name: Lance of the Ridge Chapter
lore: A knightly order that keeps its stables on a cliff.

name: Drake-Marshal of the Blue Field
lore: Musters horse and wing in the same formation.

name: Caelvane, Dragon and Crown
lore: The order will not say whether the rider commands the wyrm. The wyrm has never been asked.

divine.arrival: Crown and wing arrive together: allied Knights and Dragons gain +300 DEF for two rounds.

name: Rod-Bearer of the Choir
lore: Grounds the choir so the choir can sing louder.

name: Arc-Winged Herald
lore: Announces with a noise that is technically weather.

name: Fulgurite Archangel-Sworn
lore: Swore to an archangel and to a storm front, in that order.

name: Dominion of the Rolling Front
lore: Governs weather the way a magistrate governs a district.

name: Zeruthiel, the Stormclad Host
lore: Six wings and a charge that never fully discharges. The wings are not the frightening part.

divine.arrival: The host arrives charged: allies gain +200 ATK and enemies in the open take 250 damage each round.

name: Briar-Scaled Whelp
lore: Hatched in a hedge and never left it entirely.

name: Root-Winged Drake
lore: Roosts by growing into the roost.

name: Gallows-Grove Wyrm
lore: Cannot fly far, does not need to.

name: Hexwing Broodmother
lore: Her clutch grows rather than hatches.

name: Vethrys, the Thorned Ascent
lore: The coven planted a wyrm. It is not clear that they intended it to keep growing.

divine.arrival: The grove takes flight: all terrain within 4 becomes Forest and enemies there lose 200 hit points a round.

name: Static-Veil Scout
lore: Hides in the noise before the strike.

name: Flash-Blind Infiltrator
lore: Enters on the flash, works during the blindness.

name: Peal-Count Handler
lore: Runs cells that report only between peals.

name: Arc-Shadow Adept
lore: Two ways to cross a room, both instantaneous.

name: Kaen, the Sky Answers Quietly
lore: Calls the strike, then arrives inside the noise it makes. Witnesses report only the noise.

divine.arrival: Every light on the field fails for a round; nothing may use Overwatch.

name: Barefoot Herald
lore: Flies, but walks the last stretch out of habit.

name: Cloister-Winged Sister
lore: Keeps the cloister's hours from above it.

name: Stillpoint Seraph-Sworn
lore: Holds a stance that is also a vigil.

name: Abbot of the Upper Choir
lore: Runs an order that meets at altitude.

name: Hesperiel, the Throne of Judgement
lore: The order calls it a brother. It has four faces and none of them are looking at the order.

divine.arrival: Judgement is seated: enemies within 4 lose 25 morale and all allied statuses are cleansed.

name: Sovereign of Thresholds
lore: Presides over doorways. Was invited through one and has not left.

divine.arrival: Every portal on the field opens at once, whoever built it.

name: Sovereign of Tallies
lore: Counts. Has never been observed to stop counting.

divine.arrival: Every unit's remaining hit points are revealed to both sides permanently.

name: Sovereign of the Salt Tide
lore: Arrived with the water. The water has not gone back.

divine.arrival: Open ground within 4 becomes Water; anything standing there is pushed clear.

name: Sovereign of Unfinished Work
lore: Completes things. Nobody has agreed on what completion means to it.

divine.arrival: Every ritual in progress on the field advances by three.

name: Sovereign of the Long Winter
lore: Does not fight so much as arrive and outlast.

divine.arrival: All movement costs are doubled for two rounds, this entity excepted.

name: Sovereign of Borrowed Faces
lore: Wears the face of whoever summoned it, and keeps wearing it after.

divine.arrival: Every Hidden unit is revealed and every clone on the field expires.

name: Sovereign of the Standing Debt
lore: Collects. The terms were agreed by somebody, at some point.

divine.arrival: The summoning side loses 20 morale across the army. The debt is not optional.

name: Sovereign of Held Breath
lore: Nothing moves while it is deciding.

divine.arrival: No unit on either side may use a Reaction for two rounds.

name: Sovereign of Nine Doors
lore: Eight of them are known.

divine.arrival: Every unit on the summoning side may reposition three hexes immediately.

name: The Sovereign That Was Asked For
lore: Cults spend decades naming precisely what they want. This is what answers, and it is always technically correct.

divine.arrival: Both armies lose 30 morale. It did not come for either of them.

name: The Sovereign of the Closed Book
lore: Everything it has finished is finished. There is no record of it being asked twice.

divine.arrival: Every ritual circle on the field is closed permanently, including the one that called it.

name: The Sovereign Beneath the Anchors
lore: The Anchors were not built to hold it in. They were built to hold it down.

divine.arrival: Every enemy within 6 is rooted for two rounds; the ground under them stops counting as terrain.
